name: Repono Ltd
tagline: Cheap BSE-SME petroleum-terminalling / O&M play that has now SIGNED a 20-year Reliance EPC + O&M contract (Jun 2026) via a dedicated SPV — a real credential upgrade — offset by FY26 operating cash flow turning negative on the working-capital + terminal build, plus SME liquidity and a ~1-year public history
business_overview: Repono (BSE SME, 544463; incorporated 2017, listed Aug 2025) provides integrated operations & maintenance (O&M), logistics support and 360-degree warehousing / liquid-terminal services focused on the oil value chain (crude, ethanol, petrochemicals, lube blending, specialty chemicals, ATF) plus FFS polymer bagging. In FY26 it formalised a step-down subsidiary (Repono Mathura Terminal Pvt Ltd, the SPV for the Reliance terminal) and a 51% Saudi Arabia JV (Golden Wing Trading Company). Small ValuePickr thread (6 posts) read to June 2026.
fundamentals_table: ~15% ROE / ~17-20% ROCE (compressed from the ~27% historical figure as capital scaled ahead of revenue)
FY26 ~Rs 65.3 Cr (+29%) / ~Rs 6.6 Cr (+29%); EBITDA ~Rs 10 Cr (~15-17% margin); EPS ~Rs 6.4
~27% 5-yr CAGR; FY25 ~+27%, FY26 +29%; H1 FY26 total income +38%
FY26 operating cash flow NEGATIVE ~Rs 15 Cr; capex ~Rs 11 Cr; FCF ~ -Rs 26 Cr. Total debt ~Rs 9 Cr (up from near-zero), D/E ~0.2x. Cash conversion cycle ~46 days.
fundamentals_narrative: The headline package still looks cheap for the return profile — ~27% multi-year revenue CAGR, effectively low debt, P/E ~12.3 — but this pass surfaces two material changes. (1) The Reliance relationship has moved from an unverified 'supply/O&M agreement' to a SIGNED 20-year, multi-crore contract (announced 16 Jun 2026) under which Repono handles the full EPC phase and then lifetime O&M of a greenfield, rail-fed petrol/diesel/ethanol POL terminal in western UP, executed through a dedicated SPV, Repono Mathura Terminal Pvt Ltd. Revenue impact is still ~3 years out (roughly FY29). (2) FY26 operating cash flow was negative ~Rs 15 Cr (capex ~Rs 11 Cr; FCF ~ -Rs 26 Cr) as working capital and the terminal build scaled ahead of revenue, and ROE has compressed to ~15% (from the ~27% historical figure). A 51% Saudi Arabia JV (Golden Wing Trading Company) adds unproven new-geography optionality. The company secretary/compliance officer resigned effective 3 Jun 2026 (audit opinion for FY26 was unmodified); a GST dispute is disclosed. Promoters hold ~72%, no pledge.
technical_read: Not independently pulled. 52-week range Rs 43-107; stock roughly 2x off its low with a mid-2026 rally that community discussion attributes partly to trader activity plus the Reliance contract announcement.
sentiment_summary: Small ValuePickr thread (6 posts, highest post #7), first-time read of all inline posts, spanning Dec 2025 to June 2026. Santosh_Kadam wrote the business primer; Chandan_Sharma linked the H1 FY26 concall transcript; deepakreads (June 2026) cautioned the current rally may be trader-driven and that the Reliance agreement will take ~3 years to show in numbers, while noting the promoters are pursuing a second large contract.
community_signal: No trusted-roster users in the thread. deepakreads' post is the most balanced: positive on the Reliance credential and pipeline, cautious on near-term rally sustainability and the long revenue-recognition lag.
bse_notes: 16 Jun 2026: signed 20-year multi-crore agreement with Reliance Industries for a greenfield rail-fed POL terminal (petrol/diesel/ethanol) in western UP — full EPC scope then lifetime O&M, executed via SPV Repono Mathura Terminal Pvt Ltd. FY26: incorporated 51% Saudi JV Golden Wing Trading Company. 3 Jun 2026: company secretary / compliance officer resigned (FY26 audit opinion unmodified). GST dispute disclosed. BSE-SME listing — structurally thin liquidity.

verdict_headline: Signed 20-year Reliance EPC+O&M contract upgrades the credential and keeps this inside the 10x frame, but FY26 negative operating cash flow plus SME liquidity hold conviction at Medium
verdict_reasoning: four_box score 3.5 (tailwind now yes — a signed 20-yr contract is a structural driver; tam yes on the ~Rs 81 Cr base; moat weak; valuation yes at ~12x) supports the 10x-in-2-3-years label

Conviction stays Medium: the contract de-risks thesis credibility but adds no revenue before ~FY29, and FY26 operating cash flow turned negative (-~Rs 15 Cr) as working capital and terminal capex scaled ahead of revenue
SME liquidity, ~1 year of public history, ROE compression to ~15%, and the CS resignation / GST dispute are the offsets keeping conviction below Medium-High
